[A161] REVIEW READY: author handoff only

Exact head: `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5`. Base: `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58`. Branch: `97-assert-distinct-sr-vid-fixture`. Committed and clean locally; not pushed. Manager full validation/publication and review launch remain pending.

Review scope is the four pp_top test/documentation files. Read the frozen public issue97 acceptance, assignment, R223-S2 observation, donor README/docs guide/HDL engineer guide and relevant F01.5/F10.2 requirements. Public sources are preserved under `public/`. No private reasoning is included.

| Settled issue97 acceptance | Implementation and evidence |
|---|---|
| Refuse a verification fixture equal to default 2 at either observable width | Two fixture-only `static_assert`s in `sim_main.cpp`, using the existing `uint16_t` expectation and its `0x0FFFu` mask |
| Default and pinned 5A3C remain green | Normal two-build pp_top run: 1391 + 20 checks, 0 failures; default recipe carries no fixture define |
| 0002 and 1002 fail compilation clearly | Actual full fixture compile recipes refuse both values with width-specific diagnostics; the permanent four-case syntax-compile gate validates their exact diagnostic sets |
| Preserve missing-binding sensitivity and child-default control | M25 reproduces 13/20 fixture failures with default green; M31 remains 1391 + 20 green |
| Preserve product RTL/default/runtime policy and independent expectations | Only the Makefile, README, new compile-check script and five fixture-branch lines change; no RTL or wrapper edits, no DUT-readback-derived expectations, no runtime CHECK edits |
| Donor gates, two reviews and containment | Focused author gates pass; complete native/hosted bar, R229/R230 and merge/containment remain manager-owned |

| Evidence | Result |
|---|---|
| Normal `make -j8` in disposable candidate | rc 0; default 1391 checks / 0 failures, 5A3C fixture 20 / 0; canonical 1411 PASS / 0 FAIL |
| `make -j8 fixture-guards` | rc 0; no override and 5A3C compile; 0002 gives both width assertions, 1002 gives only the class-D assertion |
| Full fixture compile recipe, `SRP_VID_FIXTURE=0002` | expected rc 2; both named static assertions; no fixture executable |
| Full fixture compile recipe, `SRP_VID_FIXTURE=1002` | expected rc 2; class-D static assertion only; no fixture executable |
| Remove actual top-to-child VID binding, M25 | expected make rc 2; default 1391 / 0, fixture 20 / 13 failures, all in DV |
| Child `DOM_DEF_VID_P` default 2 to 7 with binding intact, M31 | rc 0; default 1391 / 0, fixture 20 / 0; canonical 1411 PASS / 0 FAIL |
| Remove each new assertion separately | expected rc 2 from `make fixture-guards`; the new regression detects either missing guard |
| `make -j8 check`, final documentation text | rc 0; 41 Mermaid and 18 WaveDrom blocks, 807 links, 115 REQ rows / 17 GAP findings, 86 module rows / 0 untested, freshness/staleness pass |
| `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` | rc 0; 37 LINT OK, zero tolerance |
| Source/format checks | Python syntax and `git diff --check` pass; no new U+2014; only four pp_top files; tested snapshot hashes match committed content |

Assigned reviewers: R229 cold internal Codex and R230 external Opus. Neither has been started by the author. Both must independently reconstruct the change from public authority and factual artifacts and publish exact-head Conformance, RTL, Robustness, Tests and Docs coverage. Author checks are not independent review or approval.

`HANDOFF.md` records limitations. `COMMANDS.md`, `receipts/`, `scripts/`, `source.patch` and `MANIFEST.json` provide reproducible commands, raw outcomes, mutation patches and hashes. `REMAINING-GATES.md` lists exact remaining mandatory commands and merge/containment discipline. No merge readiness is claimed.

[R229] POSITIVE - exact head 1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5

PP / Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan, PR100 / issue97, review round R229-1. Base: `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58`. Reviewed tree: `001d20069951396c5e056c5539c2af4217310a57`. Independent cold internal review, reconstructed from public requirements, source, history and evidence. No author/private transcripts, subagents or collaboration with the author or other reviewer were used.

No in-scope MINOR, MAJOR or BLOCKER finding remains open. No SUGGESTION is raised. All five lenses are clean for this head. This report supplies one independent positive review; the merge obligations below remain separate.

The reviewed contract is [issue97 and its public decisions](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/97), the [assignment](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/97#issuecomment-5772130908), [issue95 acceptance](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/95), and the [current review start](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/100#issuecomment-5773005345). I read `$WORKSPACE_HOME/.codex/RTK.md`, the repository README, `docs/README.md`, `hdl/README.md`, the HDL engineer guide, relevant integrator/interface/SRP/verification documentation, the single PR commit and its complete four-file diff. The baseline has no repository `AGENTS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

**Reviewer-owned coverage ledger.** Every source artifact below is at the exact head in this ledger; clean means no open finding under that lens in this review's scope.

| Lens | Covering round | Exact head | Result and checked artifacts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Conformance | R229-1 | `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5` | CLEAN. `tb/pp_top/sim_main.cpp:75–87`, README section DV; issue97; issue95 AC2; `docs/architecture/01_overview.md` F01.5, `02_interfaces.md` F02.10, `10_srp_engine.md` F10.2/§11; compliance rows REQ-NET-002 and REQ-SRP-004. Checked fixture-only distinctness, both observable widths, unchanged shipping default and received-Domain adoption. No in-scope normative conflict found. |
| RTL | R229-1 | `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5` | CLEAN. `hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:144,2147`, `hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv:80,323`, `hdl/srp/KL_srp_domain.sv` reset/link/adoption/output logic, and `tb/pp_top/pp_top_wrap.sv:332–335`. Checked the direct 16-bit parameter path and 12-bit status projection; all RTL and the wrapper are unchanged from base. Runtime controls exercise the instantiated path. |
| Robustness | R229-1 | `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5` | CLEAN. `sim_main.cpp:78–84`, `fixture_guards.py:21–55`, `Makefile:54–69`. Checked refusal after the existing uint16_t conversion and 12-bit mask, exact diagnostic validation, additional-error rejection, independent deletion of either assertion, subprocess failure propagation, fresh temporary model generation and cleanup. Independently reproduced the controls below. |
| Tests | R229-1 | `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5` | CLEAN. `fixture_guards.py`, `Makefile:54–80`, `sim_main.cpp:8242–8406,9047–9077`, `scripts/run_suites.sh`. Checked real generated headers and real bench compilation, required ordinary-run integration, four fixture cases, full build refusals, unchanged DV observations, missing-binding sensitivity, child-default independence, executable exit status and canonical two-build tally. |
| Docs | R229-1 | `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5` | CLEAN. `tb/pp_top/README.md:493–560`, especially the new lines 523–538; `docs/README.md` §2; verification document §§4,7,8 and engineer guide §§6–8. Checked documented commands, widths, diagnostic sets, fixture/product boundary, no-override behavior and compile-only coverage limits against implementation and receipts. Independent link/compliance/module-matrix checks pass. |

The two new assertions apply only under `PP_TOP_SRP_DOM_DEF_VID`. The no-override branch still expects product default 2. The fixture requirement does not impose a product parameter restriction: the product RTL still accepts its existing parameter, and the shipping/default policy remains the documented value 2. The 16-bit expectation and its low 12 bits match the actual wire/status interfaces. The new literals in the test oracle do not modify the architecture parameter registry.

The wire assertion is logically subsumed by the low-12-bit assertion for value 2, so merely checking compilation failure would not detect its removal. The permanent gate instead requires both named assertion diagnostics for `0002`. Independently removing either assertion made that gate fail at `0002`, despite the remaining assertion still rejecting compilation. For `1002`, the intact gate requires only the class-D diagnostic. An injected unrelated `#error` alongside both expected `0002` assertions also failed the gate, confirming that the expected messages cannot conceal an additional compiler error.

`fixture_guards.py` generates model headers from the real wrapper/RTL in a fresh temporary directory and compiles the actual complete `sim_main.cpp` four times. My compiler receipts retain each argv, return code, raw diagnostic output and hashes of the five generated model headers. All four cases used the same generated header set; its temporary directory was removed afterward. This is a syntax-compile gate, not a simulation of the four cases. Separate real executable builds below establish runtime behavior.

**Independent R229 execution.** Preinstalled tools: Verilator 5.052, GCC 16.2.1, Python 3.14.7 and GNU Make 4.4.1. Builds ran sequentially in disposable exact-head copies. Outer make used `-j1`; an external recorded wrapper capped Verilator's existing `-j 0` at `-j 8`. No repository build flags were edited. `job-cap-check.json` validates the effective invocations.

| Probe / receipt | Observed result |
|---|---|
| `01-fixture-guards.*`, `compiler/` | make exit 0. No override and `5A3C` compile; `0002` has exactly the wire and class-D assertion errors; `1002` has exactly the class-D assertion error. |
| `02-remove-wire.*`, `03-remove-class-d.*` | Each single-assertion deletion makes `make fixture-guards` exit 2. Positive controls compile; the missing diagnostic is detected. |
| `04-extra-error.*` | make exit 2 on the `0002` case containing both expected assertion errors plus the injected unrelated compiler error. |
| `05-ordinary-builds.*`, `ordinary-build-tally.txt` | make exit 0. Default: 1,391 checks / 0 failures. Pinned `5A3C`: 20 / 0. Exactly one canonical tally: `1411 checks: 1411 PASS, 0 FAIL`. |
| `06-full-refusal-0002*`, `06-full-refusal-1002*` | Actual `--cc --exe --build` fixture recipes extracted from `make -n run SRP_VID_FIXTURE=...`, with matching SV and C++ definitions. Both exit 2; respectively exactly two and one named assertion errors. Neither fresh build produces `obj_vid/Vpp_top_vid`. |
| `07-missing-binding.*` | Removing the actual top-to-child VID binding leaves default 1,391 / 0; fixture 20 / 13 failures, all DV observations. make exits 2. This independently reproduces README M25. |
| `08-child-default.*` | Changing only the child's own default from 2 to 7, with the top binding intact, leaves both builds green: 1,391 + 20 checks, canonical 1,411 PASS / 0 FAIL. This independently reproduces README M31. |
| `09-docs-checks.*`, `history-format-checks.json` | `make -j1 links matrix modmatrix` passes: 807 links, 115 REQ rows / 17 GAP findings, 86 module rows / 0 untested. PR diff whitespace check and Python syntax checks pass. |

`source-review.json` establishes that removing only the five newly added guard/comment lines makes `sim_main.cpp` byte-identical to base. Thus every runtime CHECK and expectation is preserved. Inspected DV coverage includes reset status, snapshot word 10 and GET_DOMAIN; full-width LINK_UP wire declaration; GET_TX_STATE VLAN; bridge-Domain adoption, event count and Lv/New wire pair; LINK_DOWN revert/silence; and subsequent LINK_UP declaration. Expectations remain independent of DUT readback. The Makefile still removes the old tally, runs both binaries and requires two tally records; the new prerequisite's output cannot match the canonical tally pattern consumed by `run_suites.sh`.

All mutations were confined to separate scratch copies. `scratch-source-differences.json` confirms each changed only its intended source file; normal and refusal source copies remain identical to the reviewed source. One initial reviewer-runner attempt stopped before the extra-error mutation because its text anchor was not unique. It was corrected in the runner only; completed results were retained. `reviewer-runner-note.txt` records this harness error. `RECEIPTS.md` and `reproduce-focused.py` provide reproducible commands without overwriting these receipts.

**Public evidence and attribution.** I inspected the [review-ready record](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/100#issuecomment-5772579387) and [archive at 77e2fb5](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/tree/77e2fb5fdfbb4c02ed7335366733b41c279018cf/review-evidence/97-r1). All 94 retrieved evidence blobs match their Git blob identities; all 92 published-manifest entries match their published SHA-256 values. The four author-tested source hashes match this head. Publicly redacted path hashes were checked against the published manifest, not against unredacted originals.

The manager's nine-command native record identifies this head/base and reports every command returning zero, including 37-module HDL lint, all 30 suites / 14,943 checks, documentation gates, generated matrix, existing Yosys portability gate, historical NVM figures and diffcheck. These full native results are manager results; I did not independently rerun the full bar. Author receipts for fixture refusal and runtime controls agree with my independent reproductions above. Other historical mutation rows remain attributed to their recorded evidence.

I independently read GitHub job metadata and raw logs; I did not rerun hosted jobs. All six completed successfully:

| Event / run | docs-gates job | suites job | portability job |

| [push 35696606554](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/actions/runs/35696606554) | 106644761647 | 106644761597 | 106644761472 |
| [pull_request 35696611002](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/actions/runs/35696611002) | 106644775908 | 106644775791 | 106644775548 |

Push jobs checked out `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5`. PR jobs checked out synthetic merge `1a1f476b6f5dd0ebc35eb0d7e45b3ff08805735d`, with parents equal to the assigned base/head and tree `001d20069951396c5e056c5539c2af4217310a57`, identical to this head. Both hosted suite logs explicitly show Verilator 5.050 and the 1,411-check pp_top / 14,943-check donor totals. These identities are retained in `hosted-*.json` and `hosted-log-*.txt`.

**Pre-existing unrelated scope.** [PP25](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/issues/25) / [PR26](https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/26) publicly track the portability-script inventory/maintenance lane excluded by issue97's assignment. `syn/yosys/run.sh` is unchanged here. Success of the existing gate is not a claim that that separate inventory gap or other historical donor audit findings have been repaired. No in-scope finding was moved to another issue or waived to obtain clean coverage.

**Limits.** This is a focused review and independent pp_top/guard/control execution, not a new full donor or parent validation sweep. I did not independently run Yosys, historical NVM figures, the full lint/suite/documentation bar, hosted workflows, hardware or an alternate C++ compiler. Normative assessment used the settled public issues and repository authoritative documents; copyrighted specification PDFs were not supplied or inspected. Local Verilator was 5.052; the pinned 5.050 results are hosted evidence with the attribution above.

**Checkout integrity.** Final HEAD remains detached at `1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5`. All 223 tracked files retain their initial SHA-256 content, file kinds and modes. The raw index remains byte-identical, SHA-256 `1b384582e45013ad727c3e89497acecb31e7813fde154117f6e63602ffafce2a`; staged-entry hash is unchanged. Working/index diffs, unmerged entries and status are empty. See `initial-*`, `final-*` and `verify-integrity.py`. No tracked source was restored or changed. No dependency installation, privileged operation, Docker/act, hardware, commit, push, public write, merge or parent change occurred.

**Pending merge obligations, separate from this positive verdict.** The manager must enforce two independent positive reviews and clean five-lens coverage at the frozen candidate, perform the required current-candidate validation, then verify actual merged-tree containment and post-merge hosted validation. This report does not discharge those manager obligations or authorize a parent pin update. Any open MINOR/MAJOR/BLOCKER under an applicable lens prevents clean coverage, including an in-scope finding copied elsewhere. A changed candidate needs coverage for that candidate.

[R230] NEGATIVE - exact head 1eb20dc4911880de10b745cc284e7dde306788b5 Reviewer R230 (cold independent external Opus), round R230-1. PR100 (`97-assert-distinct-sr-vid-fixture`) for issue #97. Base main `8452f564294300a82d56eed464276576f65f4d58`; head tree `001d20069951396c5e056c5539c2af4217310a57`. Public evidence archive `77e2fb5fdfbb4c02ed7335366733b41c279018cf/review-evidence/97-r1`. Author results are attributed to A161 and native/hosted results to A10, except where I reproduced them below. Everything I ran is in `receipts/` beside this report, and `receipts/SHA256SUMS` lists every receipt file. ## Verdict NEGATIVE, because one MINOR finding is open: R230-M1 (Robustness, Tests). The new permanent `fixture-guards` gate decides its verdict by matching English compiler text. Under a GCC that prints translated diagnostics, the gate rejects correct compiler behaviour. The default pp_top `make` then stops before either build, while base passes in the same environment. - Conformance, RTL and Docs are clean at this head. - Robustness and Tests are not clean, because of R230-M1. - There are two optional SUGGESTIONs, R230-S1 (Docs) and R230-S2 (Docs, Tests). - On substance the change does what issue #97 settled: - it refuses default-equivalent fixtures at both observable widths; - it restricts nothing in the product; - the M25 and M31 controls keep their recorded outcomes. ## Inputs read - Issue #97: the body, with its settled scope, acceptance and decision, and four comments: A10 READY TAKEOVER (the assignment), A161 TAKEN, A161 MATERIAL DECISIONS and A161 AUTHOR HANDOFF. - Issue #95: the body and its acceptance. - The PR96 R223 review, including R223-S2, which is the origin of #97. - PR100: the body and four comments: A161 REVIEW READY, A10 VALIDATION RUNNING, A10 REVIEW READY (native and hosted), and A10 INDEPENDENT REVIEW START. The PR has no review or inline comments. - Documentation: - `docs/README.md` §2 (single-source rules, which bind architecture documents 01-10) and §6. - `hdl/README.md` rules 2-4. - `docs/guides/hdl-engineer.md` §6-§8. - `docs/guides/integrator.md:66`. - `01_overview.md:166` (the F01.5 row for P-SRP-DOM-DEF-VID). - `10_srp_engine.md:196-212` (F10.2) and `:364-367` (§11). - 00 REQ-NET-002 (`:410`) and REQ-SRP-004 (`:422`). - `.github/workflows/hdl.yml` and `scripts/run_suites.sh`. - `tb/pp_top`: - `Makefile`, `README.md`, `fixture_guards.py` and `pp_top_wrap.sv:332-335`; - `sim_main.cpp:75-87`, the DV section (`:8242-8406`) and the build epilogue (`:9054-9072`). - RTL: - `protocol_processor_top.sv:137-144,2147`; - `KL_srp_top.sv:80,323`; - `KL_srp_domain.sv:42`. - The whole diff `8452f56..1eb20dc` (4 files, +90/-2) and the whole evidence archive. ## Identity and evidence (receipts 00, 01, 16) - The review clone is detached at `1eb20dc`. - Its tree is `001d200`. - Its single parent, and its merge-base with base, is `8452f56`. - It has no tracked, untracked or ignored changes. - The diff changes exactly four files: - `tb/pp_top/Makefile`, `README.md` and `sim_main.cpp`, all modified; - `fixture_guards.py`, new, mode 100644 (like the other `python3`-invoked helpers). - There is no mode change, deletion or rename, and `git diff --check` is clean. Nothing under `hdl/`, `docs/`, `scripts/`, `.github/` or `syn/` changes, and neither does `pp_top_wrap.sv`. - Author artifacts: - the author's `source.patch` is byte-identical to `git diff base..head`; - the four file hashes in `source-snapshot.json` match the head blobs. - Evidence archive: - Evidence commit `8b61b6c` (the author archive linked from the PR body) has parent `8452f56`, and `77e2fb5` has parent `8b61b6c`. - Both touch only `review-evidence/97-r1/`. - All 92 MANIFEST entries match their published SHA-256, and their `path_redacted` flags are consistent. - Manager records: - `manager/candidate.json` names this base, head and tree, with `clean: true`. - `full-native/results.json` records nine commands, all exit 0, at this head. Its `04.log` shows `PASS pp_top (1411 checks: 1411 PASS, 0 FAIL)` and `suites: 14943 checks total, 0 failing`. - I did not re-run these. - Live state: PR100 is OPEN, not draft, MERGEABLE, head `1eb20dc`, base `main@8452f56`. The refs `main`, the branch, `pull/100/head` and `pull/100/merge` (`1a1f476`) match. - Hosted runs: - `hdl` run 35696606554 (push, which checks out `1eb20dc`) and run 35696611002 (pull_request, which checks out merge `1a1f476`, tree `001d200`, identical to head) both succeeded. - All six jobs (docs-gates, suites and portability, on both events) succeeded. - Both suites logs show Verilator 5.050, `PASS pp_top (1411 checks: 1411 PASS, 0 FAIL)` and `suites: 14943 checks total, 0 failing`. - `run` depends on `fixture-guards`, so the hosted pp_top pass implies the gate passed with Verilator 5.050 and the runner's g++. ## What I ran All work ran in scratch copies under `/tmp/r230-100-r1`: a `--no-hardlinks` clone for the head, and `git archive` exports for mutants and base. - The outer `make` ran serially. - Every Verilator call went through `receipts/scripts/verilator8`, which strips `-j`, `--build-jobs` and `--verilate-jobs` and pins all three at 8. `verilator-invocations.jsonl` shows 37 invocations, all capped, and the logs show `on 8 threads`. - `TMPDIR` pointed into the scratch area, so the gate's temporary model directories could be audited. - Toolchain: Verilator 5.052, GCC 16.2.1, Python 3.14.7 and GNU Make 4.4.1. clang++ is not installed. | Receipt | Probe | Result | |---|---|---| | 02 | head `make fixture-guards` | rc 0. Default and 5A3C compile. 0002 is refused with both diagnostics and 1002 with the class-D diagnostic only. `fixture guards: 4 cases PASS`. No temp dir left behind, and the scratch clone's `git status --ignored` stays empty. | | 03 | the same gate with `LANGUAGE=de`, with `LANGUAGE=fr`, and with `LANGUAGE=de LC_ALL=C` | de and fr: GCC prints both intended diagnostics for 0002, but the gate reports `FAIL: fixture 0002: unexpected compiler result 1` and make exits 2. `LC_ALL=C`: 4 cases PASS. See R230-M1. | | 04 | head `make`, both builds | Gate PASS, then `[build default, 0x0002] 1391 checks, 0 failures` and `[build fixture, 0x5a3c] 20 checks, 0 failures`. The last line is `1411 checks: 1411 PASS, 0 FAIL`, and `build_tally.txt` holds `1391 0` and `20 0`. Only ignored outputs are created. | | 05 | head `make SRP_VID_FIXTURE=0002`, then `=1002`, each with a fresh `obj_vid` | The default build still runs (1391/0). The fixture build then fails in `sim_main.o`: 0002 gives both static assertions (`sim_main.cpp:81`, `:83`) and 1002 only `:83`. make exits 2, no `obj_vid/Vpp_top_vid` exists, and no canonical line is printed. Verilator accepted the SV override and generated the model, so only the C++ bench refused. | | 06 | six gate mutants, G1-G6, run through `make fixture-guards` (the diffs are in `*.mutation.txt`) | Every mutant fails the gate (rc 2):
• G1, the wire guard removed: 0002 shows the class-D diagnostic only.
• G2, the class-D guard removed: 0002 shows the wire diagnostic only.
• G3, the class-D mask widened to `0xFFFFu`: 1002 compiles.
